The chain has exactly two open ends: the LEFT open end is the value of the left half of the leftmost tile, and the RIGHT open end is the value of the right half of the rightmost tile (if an end tile is a vertical double, the open value is simply its value). [3] 6
[4] 5
[5] 0
[6] 2
[7] 1
